summary.text: Brandon Potter is a Democratic member of the Rhode Island House of Representatives, representing District 16 since January 5, 2021, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026; Ballotpedia lists him as the only candidate.

paragraphs.text: Brandon Potter's career experience includes working in the automobile industry.
In the 2021-2022 session he was assigned to the Corporations Committee.
